record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the uniform recent-four-state mean with a causal weighted mean using weights [1,2,3,4] from oldest to current state, renormalized over nonpadding positions. Retain the 0.8 current-state/0.2 pooled-state blend. This keeps four-state context while emphasizing immediate intent, unlike the regressed two-state window. Preserve final-real-position selection, features, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer. Update readout metadata and the predictor writer consistently.
